copy_guidance: Lead with the named person or organization plus one concrete fact, as in 'Man Utd Open Talks With Pochettino'. Avoid vague teasers.
Keep headlines to 12 words or fewer; top posts are short, single-claim lines.
Prefer Europe-angle and business/world stories for the 08:00-10:40 UTC slots; test one US or funny story per day in those slots to separate topic from timing.
For funny and viral stories, state the real event plainly in the headline and do not repeat unverified viral claims; skip stories whose only hook is a social media joke.
Add a neutral context clause (who, where, what changed) rather than opinion or loaded words, especially for Trump, Ukraine and Middle East stories.
End with a plain question or 'what to know' framing on at most 2 posts a day, to test whether it lifts comments or shares from zero.
